::: {.callout-note title="Instruction"}

Use **Quarto** or **R Markdown**. Upload **both** files to the **Assignment 5** folder on **iCollege**:

1. Your rendered **PDF**, named `A5_LastName_FirstName.pdf`.
2. Its matching source, named `A5_LastName_FirstName.qmd` or `A5_LastName_FirstName.Rmd`.

The PDF must be generated from the submitted source. **HTML alone does not satisfy the submission requirement.**

- Put your name and course number at the beginning, and label every question and subpart.
- Include any R code used to obtain your answers in executable chunks. Before generating random values, use `set.seed(8561)`.
- Your source must render from beginning to end without errors. Use LaTeX for mathematics; do not submit screenshots of answers or code.

:::
